name: Racine County, Wisconsin (United States)
description: Blue field charged with three lozenges of gold, grey and gold on a grey bar, for agriculture, recreation and industry, between the words Racine County above and the founding year 1836 below in grey.
history: Racine County is a county in southeastern Wisconsin. The flag was adopted in 2016 (created by the county's Youth in Governance Committee after interviews with residents and approved by the Racine County Board in May 2016, according to Flags of the World citing The Journal Times).
